changed-responsibilities.text: The wallet module gains two pure helpers. A new vault module owns the encrypted file and is the only module that links the age library. A new passphrase module reads a passphrase. The command module gains the wallet verbs.

ownership.text: The vault file belongs to the command that creates it. Entropy and file creation are effects at the command boundary. No state is kept after exit.

not-changed.text: Write commands, the session, the lifecycle, the wallet key flag, and the fold and preparation modules are unchanged.
